pro_tips: Keep the scope language tight: 'commercial exterior wall sign face replacement only, no electrical, no structural changes' — that helps avoid unnecessary plan review.
Upload clear photos of the existing sign and a dimensioned sketch in ACA; that is usually what speeds sign review the most.
If the sign cabinet or mounting is staying in place, say that explicitly in the application so reviewers do not treat it like a full sign replacement.
If the sign is illuminated now or may be in the future, confirm whether the city wants a separate electrical permit even if you are not touching wiring on this job.
